### Key takeaways


The **Okta Certification Circle** and **Okta Champions** represent Okta's top-tier technical advisory and thought leadership communities. These certified practitioners guide identity security strategy, advise Okta's curriculum design, and influence product innovation across global enterprise identity systems.


Recently, some of the most influential minds shaping the future of identity security lit up the Nasdaq Tower in Times Square. We are thrilled to celebrate our **Okta Certification Circle** members and **Okta Champions** with a well-deserved feature high above New York City!


## Okta’s technical leadership programs


This year’s showcase is especially meaningful, bringing together two distinct groups of leaders who help power the Okta ecosystem:


- **The Okta Certification Circle:** An elite advisory group of certified customers who provide strategic counsel on the future of[Okta Certification](https://certification.okta.com/) and[Learning](https://learning.okta.com/) , ensuring our programs reflect the real-world demands of enterprise identity security.
- **The Okta Champions:** Our top-tier MVPs who contribute across our Subject Matter Expert (SME), Certification Circle, and[Technical Architect](https://certification.okta.com/okta-technical-architect-certification-overview) programs. As true thought leaders, they create technical community content, host live knowledge sessions, and collaborate directly with our Product Design Research team to influence future product innovation.


Showcasing these dedicated practitioners on the Nasdaq Tower transforms their technical mastery into a global symbol of leadership, honoring the critical role they play in advancing security, innovation, and collective expertise across the industry.

## Why does enterprise identity certification matter in cybersecurity?


The achievements of these featured leaders highlight a broader trend in cybersecurity: certified expertise delivers measurable organizational and professional impact.


Insights from our recent[Okta Certification Impact Survey](https://www.okta.com/blog/industry-insights/okta-certification-impact-survey-2026/) reinforce the value of these credentials:


- 79% of professionals agree that having an Okta-certified specialist on staff directly reduces security risk
- 89% of certified practitioners report increased professional credibility
- 80% of practitioners feel more confident tackling complex identity challenges


Whether shaping the evolution of Okta Certification and Learning or sharing critical technical expertise with the broader community, our Certification Circle and Champions set the standard for identity leadership.


## How can security teams get certified and upskill?


Inspired to elevate your technical authority and strengthen your organization's security posture? Explore our tailored learning pathways, earn skill badges, and pursue industry-recognized certifications to chart your path forward:


- **Self-paced learning:** Earn skill badges through curated[Okta Learning](https://learning.okta.com/) tracks to build essential identity security skills.
- **Role-based certifications:** Complete proctored exams to validate your expertise with[certifications](https://certification.okta.com/) ranging from Okta Certified Professional to Technical Architect. Additional specialty certifications highlight precise expertise and help you gain a competitive advantage.
- **Enterprise learning passes:**[Silver and Gold Premier Success Plan](https://www.okta.com/services/success-and-support/) customers unlock[Expert Learning Pass](https://learning.okta.com/plan/expert-learning-pass) access, including hands-on live labs and structured exam prep modules. Contact your account team to claim your exclusive access code today.
